title: The 2026 AI Index Report
claim_or_role: Tracks rapid adoption, benchmark progress, investment, education, policy and public opinion; used to establish diffusion and institutional lag.
caveat: Large synthesis drawing on many datasets; individual figures retain their underlying methodological limits.

title: Task-Completion Time Horizons of Frontier AI Models
claim_or_role: Measures the human-task-duration level at which frontier agents reach specified success probabilities on a suite of software tasks.
caveat: A task-difficulty measure, not literal autonomous run time; software tasks do not represent all cognitive work.

title: ELIZA—a computer program for the study of natural language communication between man and machine
claim_or_role: Historical evidence that relatively simple conversational machinery could evoke strong human interpretive and social responses.
caveat: ELIZA did not possess modern language-model capabilities; social response is not evidence of understanding.

title: Machines and Mindlessness: Social Responses to Computers
claim_or_role: Reviews experiments showing that people apply politeness, reciprocity, social categories and personality expectations to computers.
caveat: Experiments involved earlier computer interfaces; magnitude and form of effects may differ for modern systems.

title: AlphaGo
claim_or_role: Documents AlphaGo's match with Lee Sedol and the cultural significance assigned to Move 37 and later AlphaGo systems.
caveat: Developer retrospective; one game and one domain do not establish general intelligence.

title: Early methods for studying affective use and emotional well-being on ChatGPT
claim_or_role: Observational and controlled work on emotional engagement with conversational AI and variation in social and emotional outcomes.
caveat: Early research with product-specific populations; does not establish long-term causal effects for all users.

title: Talk Trust and Trade-Offs: How and Why Teens Use AI Companions
claim_or_role: Nationally representative U.S. teen survey on AI companion use, social interaction and serious conversations.
caveat: Focused on U.S. teens and self-report; organization advocates precautionary restrictions.

title: A Comprehensive Report on Teens Tweens and AI
claim_or_role: Survey evidence that AI use is already widespread among U.S. children ages 9–17 and family/school safety conversations lag usage.
caveat: Self-reported U.S. sample; youth products and behavior change rapidly.

title: Guidance for generative AI in education and research
claim_or_role: Documents policy lag and proposes human-centered educational and age-appropriate approaches to generative AI.
caveat: Normative guidance rather than causal evidence of educational outcomes; updated 2026.

title: Anthropic Economic Index report: Cadences
claim_or_role: Documents shift from chat toward long-running agentic tasks and user-reported changes in speed scope quality and delegation.
caveat: Product-specific data and self-report; users are selected and not representative of the whole workforce.

title: 2026 Work Trend Index: Agents human agency and opportunity
claim_or_role: Reports worker use of agents, organizational readiness, advanced user practices and changing human-agent work patterns.
caveat: Company-sponsored research; much of the readiness and impact evidence is self-reported.

title: Enterprise signals: What frontier firms are doing differently
claim_or_role: Describes enterprise movement from assistance to delegation and the role of context and tools in agentic work.
caveat: Developer/customer-base evidence and product telemetry are not neutral economy-wide measures.

title: Generative AI and jobs: A 2025 update
claim_or_role: Estimates occupational exposure to generative AI and emphasizes that transformation is more common than direct full-job automation in its framework.
caveat: Exposure scores are task-based estimates, not realized job losses or productivity gains.

author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: Artificial Intelligence Risk Management Framework: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
claim_or_role: Provides cross-sector risk-management concepts for generative AI without relying on questions of machine personhood.
caveat: Voluntary U.S. guidance; framework is being revised and does not by itself ensure compliance or safety.

title: Regulation EU 2024/1689 Artificial Intelligence Act
claim_or_role: Provides a major statutory example of governing AI through risk categories documentation transparency and provider/deployer duties.
caveat: Phased implementation and later amendments matter; EU law is not a global template.

title: Gemini Robotics brings AI into the physical world
claim_or_role: Shows vision-language-action and embodied-reasoning systems connecting language perception planning and robot control.
caveat: Developer demonstrations under selected conditions; not evidence of general household or industrial reliability.

title: Gemini Robotics-ER 1.6: Powering real-world robotics tasks through enhanced embodied reasoning
claim_or_role: Illustrates continued work on spatial and physical reasoning for robots in 2026.
caveat: Developer-reported capability; deployment economics and robustness remain separate questions.

title: Gemini Robotics 2 brings whole body intelligence to robots
claim_or_role: Reports longer task sequences self-correction and multi-robot coordination as an embodiment trajectory.
caveat: Recent developer announcement; independent validation and real-world generalization may lag.

title: China can build kung fu-fighting robots But it can't get them to do factory work
claim_or_role: Counter-evidence on humanoid robotics: impressive demonstrations coexist with limits in factory usefulness cost precision and demand.
caveat: News reporting based on interviews and observed industry conditions; country-specific.

title: Public Opinion chapter — 2026 AI Index
claim_or_role: Tracks rising optimism and anxiety workplace use companionship expectations and trust in regulation across countries.
caveat: Aggregates surveys with differing samples and question wording; attitudes can change quickly.

title: Economy chapter — 2026 AI Index
claim_or_role: Tracks organizational adoption generative-AI diffusion investment and early agent deployment patterns.
caveat: Adoption surveys measure use more readily than depth quality or return on investment.

title: Technical Performance chapter — 2026 AI Index
claim_or_role: Provides benchmark and model-performance context including rapid gains and benchmark saturation.
caveat: Benchmark improvement is not identical to real-world reliability or general intelligence.

title: Education chapter — 2026 AI Index
claim_or_role: Documents rapid student use of generative AI and lagging clarity of school policies.
caveat: Survey evidence varies by education system and may not measure learning quality.

author_or_institution: Clifford Nass Jonathan Steuer and Ellen Tauber
title: Computers are Social Actors
claim_or_role: Foundational experiments showing automatic use of social rules in human-computer interaction.
caveat: Short early-era computer interactions; should not be overextended to modern relational AI.

title: Are People Polite to Computers? Responses to Computer-Based Interviewing Systems
claim_or_role: Demonstrates politeness effects in responses to computer interview systems.
caveat: Politeness is one social behavior and does not establish deep attachment.

title: How Frontier Firms are rebuilding the operating model for the age of AI
claim_or_role: Describes a managerial shift from tactical execution toward direction standards and evaluation as agents take on more work.
caveat: Normative company framing; claims should be cross-checked against independent labor evidence.

title: Common Sense Media Census: AI Use by Tweens and Teens 2026
claim_or_role: Reports widespread youth AI use and gaps in parent/school safety conversations.
caveat: Press release summary; underlying report should govern precise statistics.

title: Consolidated AI Act text as amended through July 2026
claim_or_role: Current consolidated legal text used to avoid relying on the original 2024 text when describing 2026 obligations.
caveat: Legal interpretation is outside the book's scope; chapter uses broad governance structure only.

author_or_institution: National Institute of Standards and Technology
title: AI Risk Management Framework program and 2026 critical-infrastructure profile work
claim_or_role: Shows continuing institutional effort to adapt risk frameworks as AI moves into consequential infrastructure.
caveat: Framework revision remains ongoing.

author_or_institution: Common Sense Media and Stanford Medicine Brainstorm Lab
title: Major AI chatbots unsafe for teen mental health support
claim_or_role: Counter-evidence against treating conversational empathy as clinical competence or safe mental-health support for minors.
caveat: Advocacy/risk-assessment framing; not a general evaluation of all adult therapeutic or supportive uses.

title: Gemini Robotics ER 2 model page
claim_or_role: Describes a high-level embodied reasoning model that can converse understand physical space plan multi-step tasks and coordinate robots.
caveat: Capability description comes from developer; independent replication may be limited.

title: AI Index overview 2026
claim_or_role: Summarizes mass adoption model convergence and the widening gap between capability and governance/evaluation readiness.
caveat: High-level summary; use chapter-specific data where possible.
